serverInfo.name: powerbi-authoring-local
serverInfo.title: Power BI Authoring MCP Server (Local)
serverInfo.description: Author Power BI semantic models in Power BI Desktop, Microsoft Fabric workspaces, and local PBIP and TMDL files.

initialize.instructions: Use this server for semantic models in Microsoft Fabric workspaces, Power BI Desktop, or PBIP and TMDL files on disk. Connect to the target semantic model, Power BI Desktop model, or local files before performing model operations. Use only this server for a given authoring task; do not combine it with the hosted Power BI Authoring server.

tools.name: measure_operations
tools.description: Perform operations on semantic model measures. All operations support both single and multiple items via list properties. Supported operations: Help, Create, Update, Delete, Get, List, Rename, Move, ExportTMDL. For Create and Update use Definitions. For Delete, Get, List, and ExportTMDL use References. For Rename use RenameDefinitions. For Move use MoveDefinitions. To move measures between tables, use the Move operation. Update operation cannot change table assignment; use Move instead. Batch options allow control over transaction behavior and error handling.

tools.name: partition_operations
tools.description: Perform operations on semantic model partitions. Supports batch operations for Create, Update, Delete, Refresh, Rename, and Get. Use the Operation parameter to specify: Help, List, Get, Create, Update, Delete, RefreshWithXMLA, RefreshWithAPI, CheckStatusOfRefreshWithAPI, CancelRefreshWithAPI, Rename, ExportTMDL, ExportTMSL. For Create and Update use Definitions. For Delete and Get use References.

tools.name: perspective_operations
tools.description: Perform operations on semantic model perspectives, perspective tables, perspective columns, perspective measures, and perspective hierarchies. Supported operations: Help, List, Get, Create, Update, Delete, Rename, ListTables, GetTables, AddTables, UpdateTables, RemoveTables, ListColumns, GetColumns, AddColumns, RemoveColumns, ListMeasures, GetMeasures, AddMeasures, RemoveMeasures, ListHierarchies, GetHierarchies, AddHierarchies, RemoveHierarchies, ExportTMDL. Use the Operation parameter to specify which operation to perform. PerspectiveName is required for all operations except List.

tools.name: transaction_operations
tools.description: Perform operations on Analysis Services transactions. Supported operations: Help, Begin, Commit, Rollback, GetStatus, ListActive. Use the Operation parameter to specify which operation to perform.

tools.name: relationship_operations
tools.description: Perform operations on semantic model relationships. Supported operations: Help, List, Get, Create, Update, Delete, Rename, Activate, Deactivate, Find, ExportTMDL. Use the Operation parameter to specify which operation to perform.

tools.name: trace_operations
tools.description: Perform trace operations on semantic models to capture and analyze Analysis Services events. Supported operations: Help, Start, Stop, Pause, Resume, Clear, Get, List, Fetch, ExportJSON. Use the Operation parameter to specify which operation to perform.

tools.name: connection_operations
tools.description: Perform operations on Microsoft tabular semantic model data source connections (PowerBI Desktop, Analysis Services, Fabric). Supported operations: Help, Connect, ConnectFabric, ConnectFolder, ConnectBimFile, Disconnect, GetConnection, ListConnections, ListLocalInstances. Use the Operation parameter to specify which operation to perform.

tools.name: object_translation_operations
tools.description: Perform operations on object translations within semantic model cultures. Supported operations: Help, Create, Update, Delete, Get, List. Use the Operation parameter to specify which operation to perform. Supported object types: Model, Table, Measure, Column, Hierarchy, Level, KPI.

tools.name: table_operations
tools.description: Perform operations on semantic model tables. All operations support both single and multiple items via list properties. Supported operations: Help, Create, CreateFieldParameter, Update, Delete, Get, List, RefreshWithXMLA, RefreshWithAPI, CheckStatusOfRefreshWithAPI, CancelRefreshWithAPI, Rename, MarkAsDateTable, GetSchema, ExportTMDL, ExportTMSL. For Create and Update use Definitions, for Delete, Get, Refresh, GetSchema, ExportTMDL, and ExportTMSL use References, and for Rename use RenameDefinitions. Batch options allow control over transaction behavior and error handling.

tools.name: database_operations
tools.description: Perform database-level operations on semantic models hosted in Power BI Desktop or Fabric service, or loaded offline from TMDL/BIM. Use List to enumerate databases and retrieve their names, IDs, compatibility levels, states, and processing timestamps. Supported operations: Help, Create, Update, List, ImportFromTmdlFolder, ExportToTmdlFolder, ImportFromBimFile, ExportToBimFile, ExportTMDL (YAML-like format), ExportTMSL (JSON script format), DeployToFabric. Use the Operation parameter to specify which operation to perform.

tools.name: security_role_operations
tools.description: Perform operations on semantic model security roles and table permissions. All CRUD operations support both single and multiple items via list properties. Supported operations: Help, Create, Update, Delete, Get, List, Rename, CreatePermissions, UpdatePermissions, DeletePermissions, GetPermissions, ListPermissions, GetEffectivePermissions, ExportTMDL, ExportTMSL. For Create, Update, Delete, Get, and Rename operations, provide a list of definitions or references even for single items. Batch options allow control over transaction behavior and error handling.

tools.name: column_operations
tools.description: Perform operations on semantic model columns. All operations support both single and multiple items via list properties. Supported operations: Help, Create, Update, Delete, Get, List, Rename, ExportTMDL. Use the Operation parameter to specify which operation to perform. For Create and Update use Definitions, for Delete, Get, List, and ExportTMDL use References, and for Rename use RenameDefinitions. Batch options allow control over transaction behavior and error handling.

tools.name: calendar_operations
tools.description: Perform operations on semantic model calendars and their column groups. All operations support both single and multiple items via list properties. Supported operations: Help, Create, Update, Delete, Get, List, Rename, ExportTMDL, CreateColumnGroups, UpdateColumnGroups, DeleteColumnGroups, GetColumnGroups, ListColumnGroups. Use the Operation parameter to specify which operation to perform. For Create, Update, Delete, Get, and Rename operations, provide a list of definitions or references even for single items. List and ExportTMDL work with individual items. Calendar objects define logical calendars as part of DAX Time-Intelligence support and are only supported when compatibility level is at least 1701. Batch options allow control over transaction behavior and error handling.

tools.name: model_operations
tools.description: Perform operations on semantic model. Supported operations: Help, Get, Create, Update, RefreshWithXMLA, RefreshWithAPI, CheckStatusOfRefreshWithAPI, CancelRefreshWithAPI, GetStats, Rename, ExportTMDL. Use the Operation parameter to specify which operation to perform. ExportTMDL exports the model to TMDL format.

tools.name: calculation_group_operations
tools.description: Perform operations on semantic model calculation groups and calculation items. Supports batch operations for creating, updating, deleting, getting, and renaming multiple groups and items at once. Supported operations: Help, CreateGroup, UpdateGroup, DeleteGroup, GetGroup, ListGroups, RenameGroup, CreateItems, UpdateItems, DeleteItems, GetItems, ListItems, RenameItems, ReorderItems, ExportTMDL. Use the Operation parameter to specify which operation to perform.

tools.name: dax_query_operations
tools.description: Perform DAX query operations on semantic models. Supported operations: Help, Execute, Validate, ClearCache. Use the Operation parameter to specify which operation to perform.

tools.name: named_expression_operations
tools.description: Perform operations on semantic model named expressions and Power Query parameters. All operations support both single and multiple items via list properties. Supported operations: Help, Create, Update, Delete, Get, List, Rename, CreateParameter, UpdateParameter, ExportTMDL. For Create, Update, CreateParameter, and UpdateParameter operations, provide Definitions. For Delete, Get, and ExportTMDL operations, provide References. For Rename, provide RenameDefinitions. Batch options allow control over transaction behavior and error handling.

tools.name: query_group_operations
tools.description: Perform operations on semantic model query groups. All operations support both single and multiple items via list properties. Supported operations: Help, Create, Update, Delete, Get, List, ExportTMDL. For Create and Update operations, provide Definitions. For Delete, Get, and ExportTMDL operations, provide References. Batch options allow control over transaction behavior and error handling.

tools.name: function_operations
tools.description: Perform operations on semantic model functions. Supported operations: Help, Create, Update, Delete, Get, List, Rename, ExportTMDL. Use the Operation parameter to specify which operation to perform. Use Definitions for Create and Update operations, and References for Delete, Get, and ExportTMDL operations.

tools.name: user_hierarchy_operations
tools.description: Perform operations on semantic model user hierarchies. All operations support both single and multiple items via list properties. Supported operations: Help, List, Get, Create, Update, Delete, Rename, GetColumns, AddLevels, RemoveLevels, UpdateLevels, RenameLevels, ReorderLevels, ExportTMDL. For Create, Update, Delete, Get, Rename, and level operations, provide a list of definitions or references even for single items. Batch options allow control over transaction behavior and error handling.

tools.name: culture_operations
tools.description: Perform operations on semantic model cultures. All operations support both single and multiple items via list properties. Supported operations: Help, Create, Update, Delete, Get, List, Rename, GetValidNames, GetValidDetails, GetDetailsByName, GetDetailsByLCID, ExportTMDL. For Create, Update, Delete, Get, and Rename operations, provide a list of definitions or references even for single items. List, GetValidNames, GetValidDetails, GetDetailsByName, GetDetailsByLCID, and ExportTMDL work with individual items. Batch options allow control over transaction behavior and error handling.

prompts.name: CreateDAXQuery
prompts.description: Creates a DAX query based on your semantic model and natural language question.

prompts.name: RunDAXQueryWithMetrics
prompts.description: Executes the DAX query with option to clear the cache and return only the execution metrics.

prompts.name: ConnectToPBIP
prompts.description: Loads the TMDL definition from the semantic model in the Power BI Project (pbip) files.

prompts.name: ConnectToPowerBIDesktop
prompts.description: Searches for the Power BI Desktop Analysis Services instance that matches the file name and connects to it.

prompts.name: ConnectToFabric
prompts.description: Connects to a semantic model in a Fabric Workspace.

prompts.name: AnalyzeDAXQuery
prompts.description: Analyzes DAX query performance by running it with a cleared cache and reviewing execution metrics for potential issues.
